payload.body_they: {{Name}} can become attached to what a path means before they know if they like the life that comes with it. They may believe deeply in the program, organization, project, or visible role while the daily reality keeps asking for something different. Potential can keep them invested long after the current version has stopped working. Believing in what something could become and wanting what it is asking from them now are different questions.
